locator: I.16 [3]: God is the first being and the first cause
interpretation: Aquinas asserts that God is the first being and the first cause 'as is evident from what was said above', i.e. from SCG I.13, where God was reached as the first unmoved mover ([3], [28]), the first efficient cause ([33]) and what is supremely being ([34]). Read as a back-referenced assertion, not an argument: I.16 does not show that the first unmoved mover of I.13 is the first being; it takes the God of I.13 to be the first being. It therefore bears on the open bridge STMT-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER-IS-FIRST-BEING without supplying it. Basis: the English translation named in the passage manifest; a candidate for upgrade once a pinned Latin witness exists, and never a ground for overriding a reading of the Leonine/SCTA Latin.
